context: Add scripts/pr_refresh_replay.py and deterministic fixtures. Use GitHub run/check metadata and Git objects as read-only inputs, store a bounded durable report under _project/audits, and separate observed facts from estimates. Report Develop PR and whole-event runner-minutes, required-gate wall time, all-workflow wall time, eligibility hit rate, fallback reasons, and full-only failures. Absence of failures is evidence, not proof.
description: Build a reproducible historical replay and adversarial evidence set for the shadow classifier. Cover every explicit branch refresh since strict activation, a longer pre-activation synchronize window where evidence is available, all full-CI failures on refresh-like heads, and synthetic negative controls. Measure whether the proposed shadow eligibility decision would have hidden a lint, fast-test, medium-test, correctness, plan-capture, browser, ruleset-drift, or other synchronize-workflow failure.
